s.en: modify and show local node parameters or list peer nodes

syn: tipc node set { address ADDRESS | netid NETID } ⏎ tipc node get { address | netid } ⏎ tipc node list

o.en: Show help about last valid command. For example tipc node --help will show node help and tipc --help will show general help. The position of the option in the string is irrelevant.
